captcha_work.note: REQUIRED: Replace with your actual CAPTCHA app package and activity name. See README for how to find these.

coordinates.note: REQUIRED: Adjust these based on YOUR phone's screen resolution and app layout. See README for instructions.

captcha_crop.note: REQUIRED: Region where CAPTCHA image appears on YOUR screen

delays.note: OPTIONAL: Adjust based on your phone's performance. Increase if phone is slow, decrease for faster phones.

ocr.note: OPTIONAL: Supported languages: en, ch_sim, ch_tra, ja, ko, ar, etc. Adjust min_confidence (0.0-1.0) for accuracy.

adb.note: OPTIONAL: Set device_serial if you have multiple devices. Example: '192.168.1.100:5555' for wireless
